_readme: Round v10, recovery (pre-registered in ROADMAP; the author's choice after the stuck-on-a-rejected-word diagnosis). Base: sft-gemma270m-v8-s3 (select alone 83.9%). Each GPU lets the base play 4,273 training-side hidden words alone, turns every first rejection of its own non-word into boards with a real word that fits as the target, mixes in 4% of the v8 data as replay, and fine-tunes the base for two epochs (lr 2e-5). Then: alone on select and heldout, retry-3, the leaderboard rule, and, if alone on select is at least the base, word-level decoding.
